user.title: Set up Log Doctor
user.description: Log Doctor scans your Home Assistant log, matches problems against a built-in knowledge base and (optionally) live research on the Home Assistant docs, Community forum, and GitHub, and reports what it finds. It never changes your configuration.

data.enable_github_lookup: Research unmatched anomalies online (Home Assistant docs, Community forum, GitHub)
data.github_token: GitHub personal access token (optional, raises GitHub's rate limit only)
data.max_github_queries: Max anomalies researched online per scan
data.report_retention_days: Days to keep old report files on disk
data.include_supervisor_logs: Also check Supervisor, Host, and add-on logs (Home Assistant OS/Supervised only)
